content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere (a search for "insurance" returns no results, and the section outline shows no insurance heading). TrueLink is a hosting/services vendor that hosts our Web Site, operates the Interface and transmits Client Content and consumer credit data, and its liability for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11 is capped at 12 months' hosting/support fees (p0077), so the mutual indemnity in Section 12(b) is unsupported by any coverage. Under the playbook this is a deviation requiring insertion of standard coverage. We inserted a new Section 31 immediately after Section 30 (Force Majeure), the last substantive miscellaneous provision, requiring CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber liability of USD 5M (TrueLink processes our data), workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. The obligation binds the counterparty only, so it does not create any burden on us; the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is offered in the comment.

ops.text: INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law; and, because TrueLink hosts, transmits and otherwise processes Client Content and other Client and consumer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink hosts our web site and processes our and our customers' credit data, so we added our standard insurance requirements (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request) to back the indemnity in Section 12. If these limits are an issue, we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.
proposal.summary: Insert new Section 31 requiring TrueLink to carry CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation insurance and provide certificates on request.
